task.title: Set up a phone-friendly rest break
task.summary: Choose a quiet setting for future sick-day rests while keeping calls or messages from important contacts possible.
steps: Open your phone’s quiet, focus, or Do Not Disturb settings.
Choose which important contacts, if any, can still reach you; check calls and messages separately.
Save the setting or note the steps to switch it on and off when resting.
task.done_when: You know how to quiet your phone and allow chosen contacts through.
